title: Organisation
caption: Before the recording starts: recording, tools and breaks.
recording: The theory Episodes are recorded for YouTube; the hands-ons are not.
questions: Questions: raise your hand in Zoom, and I pause the recording first.

talking-points.description: Say this before the recording starts. Only the theory Episodes are recorded. Have an AI chat open, ideally Gemini or Claude, which build the HTML page best; ChatGPT and Copilot work too. Two breaks: at 1:20 and at 2:20.

pause-first.description: Pause the recording before taking a question, so no participant's voice lands on YouTube.
